dresses.line: I will pack all my pretty dresses
stanza: I will pack all my pretty dresses
I will box up my high-heeled shoes
A sparkling ring for every finger
I'll put away and hide from view

dresses.line: I keep you in the pockets of my dresses
stanza: I keep you in the pockets of my dresses
And the bristles of my brushes
Spin you into my curls today

dresses.line: Oh, I can see us now—in our bathing dresses—
stanza: Oh, I can see us now—in our bathing dresses—
You in a nice navy—and me, stripes perhaps
